WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT p.category, p.id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units
    FROM products AS p
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY p.category, p.id, p.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT category, name, units,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY units DESC) AS sales_rank
    FROM product_sales
)
SELECT category, name AS product_name, units
FROM ranked
WHERE sales_rank = 1
ORDER BY category, product_name;
